description: The quotient modulo the ideal of subsets of S is order-isomorphic, hence Boolean-isomorphic, to the power set of the complement of S; the forward map restricts a representative outside S and the inverse takes its ambient class.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.fixedRegionIso.{u} {α : Type u} (S : Set α) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.SmallQuotient (Order.Ideal.principal S) ≃o Set { x // x ∉ S }
